title: Your Phone Doesn't Store Your Fingerprint! 👆
description: When you register your fingerprint, your phone never saves a picture of it! See how the sensor reads your finger and turns it into secret codes.

scenes.text: It knows you in one touch!
scenes.say: You place your finger and the phone unlocks in a split second. How does it know it's really you?

scenes.caption: Ridges and valleys
scenes.say: Your finger is covered in raised ridges with tiny gaps between them, in a pattern unlike anyone else's.
The sensor has thousands of tiny points. Ridges that touch it change the electric charge, gaps don't. That's how it draws a precise map of your print.

scenes.text: It stores key points as encrypted codes
scenes.say: The surprise? Your phone doesn't save a picture of your fingerprint. It only keeps key points, like where ridges split or end, as encrypted codes in a protected chip.
Even identical twins, with nearly the same genes, have completely different fingerprints.
